email_account.title: Purchase emails: account
email_account.description:
Order emails from stores you choose become purchase cards you can match to garments. Laundry Hub only reads (never sends, deletes or moves) mail. Only emails from the stores you opt in to are read. Their text is sent to the AI provider behind your AI Task entity to find the items; nothing else is sent.

Gmail needs 2-Step Verification and an app password: Google Account → Security → [App passwords]({app_password_url}). Use the app password here, not your normal password.

data_description.password: A 16-letter Google app password. It's stored in Home Assistant like the core IMAP integration stores its password.
data_description.provider: Gmail uses imap.gmail.com and searches All Mail. Choose Generic IMAP for another provider.

email_server.title: Purchase emails: IMAP server
email_server.description: Server details for your email provider. The connection uses SSL.

data_description.folder: The folder to read, for example INBOX.

email_stores.title: Purchase emails: stores
email_stores.description: Choose the stores whose order emails should become purchase cards. Nothing is read from stores you don't choose. {count_note} The store list is best effort; add any other store's sender domain below.

data_description.purchase_custom_domains: Comma-separated, for example shop.example.com, mystore.com. Subdomains match too. Shared senders (narvar.com, shopifyemail.com) can't be added on their own: add the brand's own Narvar subdomain, or use Shopify stores by name.
data_description.purchase_shopify_names: Comma-separated shop names, for example First Tactical. Shops on Shopify all send from the same address, so an email counts only when the name appears in the sender's name or the subject.

data.purchase_backfill: On the first check, look back

data_description.purchase_clothing_only: Skip items that aren't clothing, shoes or accessories (for example batteries in an Amazon order).
data_description.purchase_archive_days: Cards you haven't matched or dismissed are archived after this many days.

email_disconnect.title: Purchase emails: disconnect
email_disconnect.description: Deletes the stored email address and app password. There are {cards} purchase cards.

app_people.title: App access: people
app_people.description: Choose which person each Home Assistant user is. Members see, tap and edit only that person's garments. Leave a user empty to give them no garments. A user linked to a person in Settings → People starts with that person.
